headline: Anthropic shares close below the IPO price
dek: According to CNBC and TechCrunch, the stock fell Tuesday as banks began coverage with buy ratings.

s2.label: What happened
s2.title: Below the offering
body: Shares fell 6.5% on Tuesday and closed below the $83 IPO price (CNBC Technology).
Midday they touched $76, according to TechCrunch AI.

s3.label: How it works
s3.title: The sector slid
s3.body: The drop came amid broad volatility in AI stocks.

points.t: Nvidia, AMD and Intel also fell (CNBC Technology).
CoreWeave, IREN and Nebius dropped in the session (CNBC Technology).
Fell more than 7%, giving back part of its gain (TechCrunch AI).

s4.label: Why it matters
s4.title: Why it matters
body: Trading below the IPO price is usually read as a negative sign (TechCrunch AI).
The stock may serve as a gauge for the AI sector, TechCrunch AI says.

items.t: Three banks began coverage with favorable ratings (CNBC Technology).
Canaccord sees a $135 price target, CNBC Technology reports.
Competition and compute commitments remain risks (CNBC Technology).

caption.hook: Anthropic shares closed below the IPO price.
body: According to CNBC, Anthropic shares fell 6.5% on Tuesday and closed below the $83 IPO price. TechCrunch saw the stock as low as $76 midday. The drop came as other AI stocks such as Nvidia, AMD and Intel also fell (CNBC Technology).

According to TechCrunch, trading below the IPO price is usually read as a negative sign, and the stock may serve as a gauge for the sector. Even so, three banks began coverage with favorable ratings, and Canaccord sees a $135 price target (CNBC Technology). A price target is an analyst's opinion, not a guarantee.
